integrity.mathematical_methods: Analytic scalar equilibrium elimination and two implicit-function arguments, supplemented by a symbolic exact-rational witness.
integrity.originality_scope: Model-specific remote subthreshold coexistence and distinct singular root scales, not novel implicit-function or bifurcation techniques.
integrity.priority_uncertainty: Potential unpublished details associated with a 2024 conference abstract on arbitrary Hill powers remain unverified.
integrity.verification: Self-review passed; exact algebraic witness independently reproducible with included Python/SymPy checker.

scientific_limitations: Existence of two positive equilibria is established for fixed baseline parameters and sufficiently large environmental susceptible response; it is not a stability statement for either endemic equilibrium.
No uniqueness or exact fold threshold is asserted in the general nonlinear family; the explicit rational witness has exactly two positive roots.
The construction does not establish epidemiological realism for arbitrarily large environmental infection coefficients; independent publication-priority review is not performed.
title: Hidden subthreshold endemic branches for high-order environmental transmission
